additional_info.subject: Notes from Customer
additional_info.body: An emergency button activation was reported at the charging station. Upon visiting the site and physically releasing the emergency button, the HMI did not display the expected error code indicating "Emergency Button Pressed." Further investigation is required to identify the root cause and ensure proper error detection and logging.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0413285-DC/Si-D/AE - [OgNWdN] "Emergency Button Pressed" not displayed in HMI CRM:00796001451
additional_info.body:
Dear Kaushak,
Thank you for your email.
I completely agree with your point that the emergency button was pressed after the authorization for charging ("idTag": B9DA913A). Please find the OCPP logs attached for your reference.
However, if the emergency button was pressed after authorization for charging, the HMI should clearly indicate that the emergency button has been activated. Otherwise, a new customer arriving at the charger would have no way of knowing that the emergency button was pressed, potentially causing confusion.
Could you please confirm how this situation is currently handled and whether the HMI can display an appropriate message?
Looking forward to your feedback.
Regards,
Nadeem
